nom: Clinique Redness Solutions Soothing Face Cleanser

avis.texte: This cleanser has helped my sensitive and very tempermental skill like nothing I have ever tried (and I have tried a lot). Initially I didn't like the thicker creamy consistency because I am prone to breakouts. However, within the first few days my skin looked so much calmer and smoother with zero irritation/breakouts. I almost can't believe it. I use this in the morning and my skin looks incredible all day and balanced without being oily or dry. This cleanser is a win and I hope Clinique doesn't change the formula.

This product does not lather, and it doesn't remove makeup or sunscreen, but it also does not trigger my reactive skin. While it contains a small smattering of gentle, hydrating ingredients, I'm surprised that Clinique's massive R&D department hasn't released an update to include add any one or combination of redness-soothing centella, niacinamide, azaleic acid, colloidal oatmeal, or even the hyperpigmentation protective properties of vitamin C.
This product was included in a kit I purchased, and this is now my only cleanser. I just love it! It makes my skin feel so soft and fresh and it's moisturizing. Highly recommend!
I have extremely sensitive skin so thought this cleanser would be good but I had a terrible allergic reaction and had blisters and bumps that took days to clear up.

avis.titre: Helped redness but clogged pores. No real cleansing power.
avis.texte: I really wanted to love this product, and in fact, purchased it twice. After reading other reviews that the cleanser was more like a lotion and reported to not be very foamy or bubbly, I chose to only use it in the morning, never at night to wash makeup off my face. So my routine became Clinique in the morning, and Purpose face wash (which I've been using for about 15 years) at night, and I felt that I saw improvement in my facial redness! Yay! I was so excited with my new routine I snapped up another bottle on sale...but then...by the end of the first bottle, I noticed that my pores looked larger and upon a closer look, the pores on my nose and cheeks were quite congested and just...well gross. Surely I would have ended up with some nasty blackheads if I had continued on with my routine. It's been a couple weeks since I cut out this Clinique cleanser, and my pores are calming down, looking less congested. My redness is back though. How very disappointing. I would love to return my unused second bottle, but since it shipped with some teeny tiny free samples that I gave away to coworkers, I apparently cannot recieve a refund without shipping back the cleanser AND all the teeny tiny samples. Again, how very disappointing.

I have very senstive skin with type 1 rosacea. So far this has been the only cleanser I have used that has not irritated my face or left it with a burning sensation. Can't say it is a cure for the redness but it certainly does not aggravate it. The only downsides for me are the price and added coloring.

At 61, I have tried too many products to list. I've noticed that my skin has changed and not for the better. This product has been wonderful for my face. If you suffer with Rosacea or weird breakouts you might want to give this a try. I use the whole product line and love it!

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again
avis.texte: This product was everything. It stated it would be hundred percent would buy again.
I love this cleanser! It is so gentle that it didn't irritate my skin when once I forgot to rinse. It almost feels like moisturizer.

I had read the reviews about no bubbles, but I decided to try it anyway. It's very effective on calming redness. I also bought the cream to use after washing my face. Make sure you rinse with a lot of water, and I used a washcloth, this way your face feels clean afterwards. I would recommend. I have used other brands for the after-wash cream. I like that this is a duo. And I didn't find any other brands that have a redness solution face wash. It's a good pair.

I have been diagnosed with rosacea, and this product gets rid of nearly all my redness. My dermatologist is so impressed! I use it along with the Redness Solutions moisturizer. My skin looks great! The product is a little pricey but I feel it's worth it.

avis.titre: takes some getting used to but works
avis.texte: this cleanser takes some getting used to because it makes NO foam, rather like cleansing with moisturizer; it's an unsatisfying feeling; however, it leaves one with no redness, no breakouts, and a clean feeling, so i recommend it
I don't know if it is supposed to but the cleanser does not make any bubbles it's like lotion not a cleanser it does not clean my face.
I love the Clinique red solution face cleaner, helps tone down my redness and leaves my skin soft.
I'm in my mid-50s and don't need harsh abrasives in my cleansers. I follow this up with the Redness Solutions lotion.
I have aging, sensitive skin and I am so glad Clinique has made this cleanser available. It really is soothing!
After years of trying different products for my rosacea, this one finally did the trick. This cleanser feels good on my face and actually reduces my rosacea rashes. A definite repurchase.

My favorite cleanser ever I have sensative skin as well rosacea and it helps my redness so much! Not greasy, unscented, cooling, gentle, does not have suds (which I really love) and doesnt strip my skin!
This cleanser is soothing and doesn't dry out my skin. It removes makeup easily and leaves my skin feeling clean and calm. Great for sensitive skin!

avis.titre: I will buy this product again and again
avis.texte: I love Clinique Redness Solutions Soothing Face Cleanser for my sensitive skin. It definitely calms the redness on my face and makes your skin feel and look good. It is the best product around if you have rosacea!!
I have VERY SENSITIVE SKIN 🥺 This is a must buy it calms the red tint to my skin & doesn't burn me ...

bought the travel set that includes the face wash, moisturizer and sunscreen routine. I was very hopeful it would treat my redness but after 2 months of using it daily twice a day it did nothing for me. The cleanser is very gentle and cleans the face well but again paying this much for a cleanser isn't worth it.
This is a very moisturizing cleanser and it calms and sooths redness and irritation.
Helps keep my rosacea under control. I use it twice a day and it does not dry out my skin. Please do not discontinue!
Love this cleanser for my face! My skin is very sensitive and prone to drying out/breaking out with the other cleansers. I absolutely love this product! Hopefully, they'll make it travel size soon ;)

avis.titre: My super sensitive skin is so happy!
avis.texte: I have eczema and rosacea, which can be so frustrating at times. I also have skin that is super sensitive to oils, and with all of the "face oil craze" going on at the moment, it's been almost impossible to find a regime that doesn't make me break out or make my redness worse. I stuck with this cleanser (and the redness moisturizer) for several weeks, and it 100% helped my skin. I broke out a little bit at first, but that always happens when I switch products. After 2 weeks, my skin was calm and happy. Thank you so, so, so, soooo much. Please never stop making these redness solutions products.

avis.titre: Gently cleanses my 70 year old skin
avis.texte: I double cleanse with Soothing Cleanser and Take The Day Off Cleansing Oil. Take The Day Off Cleansing Balm is too heavy for me. The oil helps to remove any sunscreen I am wearing. And because my skin is thinning with age, Soothing Cleanser helps to cleanse and comfort my skin. It's ingredients help to soothe areas of redness on my mid-face and chin, so there is much less reactive redness from using products that are too strong for my skin type.

This cleanser is gentle but cleans well and soothes redness. It does not dry out your skin. I like the consistency of it. I am not fond of foam and balm cleaners. Liquid cleaners I am okay with. While they call this a cream it is not greasy or guppy. This is one of the few cleansers out there specifically formulated and designed to sooth redness. I honestly do not know what I would do if they stop making it.

avis.titre: Great gentle cleanser, second step for double cleanse
avis.texte: I double cleanse, first with Take the Day Off balm and then this soothing cleanser. I've been using this for a couple of years now at least, and hope it is never discontinued. I have dry/combination skin that can get irritated so I avoid all foaming cleansers.

I discovered this product several years ago after I had a really bad reaction to a retinol product. I went to the Clinique counter with a severely damaged skin barrier and they recommended the Redness Relief pack. My skin was immediately relieved and it healed in record time. Ever since then, I have been hooked on both the cleanser and the cream. Being peri-menopausal and with very picky and sensitive skin, these products ensure that my skin stay in check. I don't use make up but I use SPF on the daily and I re-apply. At night I do a double cleanse with this beautiful cleanser and just by itself in the morning. It works beautifully, totally recommend.
Calm sensitive skin but still need to add something for exfoliation. I used milk exfoliation from another brand after this cleanser.

I have always had issues with moisturizers and face cleansers. Pretty much went through too many to say. I used this one as a last resort, and I'm glad I did. My face has always been red, and has ALWAYS burned when using cleansers or creams. This one keeps my face soft all day, doest burn at all. Each person to their own, I just happen to love this one

I started getting redness in my face when I hit my 40s. For the last 3 years I finally found a product that works! It started working immediately and my skin feels so soft! I have dry, sensitive, fair skin. Please don't ever discontinue this product!!!!

I purchased this as a trio with the other redness skincare line. They caused hives, BURNING my skin and it's still red...and itchy (thanks Clinique). I have rosacea acne and this is such a misleading miserable product.

This is the second product I have tried from the Redness Solutions line. I have previously ordered and reordered Redness Solutions cream and love it. I have skin type 1 with dry eczema prone skin, especially in the winter. I use this cleanser typically at night. It does remove a face full of makeup without using a remover before. I do not like to use a liquid that I have to pull and tug my skin to get the makeup off. I will say I did have to double cleanse to get all my eye makeup off ( which is pretty standard IMO for other cleansers I have used for makeup removal). It does not burn or sting eye area if rubbed when washing.
I have sensitive skin so I only use this every other day. I haven't noticed any change. I wouldn't buy it again

avis.titre: Not for sensitive skin - caused major inflammation
avis.texte: I have been using another skin care company for years - however, I like to add the 100H moisturizer and occasionally the Dramatically Different moisturizer. I struggle with redness and constant battle with blemished mostly caused from mild rosacea. I purchased this cleanser along with the matching primer to help neutralize the redness and uneven tone (since it has a green tint). I used ONLY these items for 3 days and had to stop immediately. The burning was unbearable, my face was throbbing and the flare up caused major peeling and worsened the very few blemished areas I had existing. By day 3 I looked horrible and my skin was majorly dry. I heard that there is hydrocortizone in this and maybe the percentage that is used is to much for my skin to handle. Not sure - but I sadly will be returning to Ulta. Im bummed because I thought something with the words SOOTHING or Redness would be what I needed.
I use redness solutions cleanser more than 10 years already. This is my must have. It calms redness, hydrates and feels really good on my skin.

avis.titre: Perfect if you have rosacea and really dry skin
avis.texte: I have rosacea so when I decided I wanted to try a Clinique cleanser this was the first one I tried. It was very emollient and didn't aggravate my redness, but at the same time I didn't feel like it really cleaned my face. It's at least worth a shot if you have rosacea.

avis.titre: No more red, melts makeup onto your face
avis.texte: Takes red away but does not remove makeup! It just smears makeup all over! Like rubbing oil all over your face!

avis.titre: I will continue buying this to remove my makeup
avis.texte: I wash my make up off with this! Works very well. I don't know why they said it doesn't clean because it does!

avis.titre: Not For My Rosacea and Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I have rosacea and sensitive skin. First few days this worked ok. While my skin didn't really feel clean or remove makeup, it did initially reduce the redness. Then after a few days my face got redder and started to itch. I stopped using and the issues stopped. I wasn't sure what to make of that because Clinique is known for making products for sensitive skin without fragrance. I had never had an issue with another product from them and use several. I even waited a few months and tried again. Same thing.

This cleanser is really gentle, which I love. Other cleaners make my face dry and tight, but not this one! The only thing that could be better is that it doesn't remove all of my makeup. If I use this product first, I still need to use micellar water afterwards to get off my foundation. But that is okay - I will still use this product.

Totally surprised by these products! I have for whatever reason just developed a pretty severe case of rosacea. I know there's no cure, it's a constant battle, but by adding these products along with my anti-inflammatory diet and sun avoidance, etc., In about three days there has been MARKED improvement in my skin/redness that I never expected. Along with these products, this trial pack, I did add the moisture surge intense by Clinique, where I was able to get a small trial size, and a bottle of 'The Ordinary' Hyaluronic Acid for another extra layer of extra moisture. My advice to you is if you're on the fence buying 'more products', that just seems beforehand to be another 'waste of time and money', do it…and give them a chance. I was totally taken aback, chances are you will be too.

I have super sensitive skin and have been looking for any sort of skincare product that won't leave my skin red, dry or irritated. When I went to Ulta to explore the skincare section the employee heavily expressed that this would help relieve and take away any redness or irritation. However, it did the opposite. The first few times I used it, it was great, but as I kept on using it the product was making my face red and irritated each time I applied. In my opinion, I would save your money and keep exploring because if you have sensitive skin like me, this product probably won't work.

This is the best cleanser I have ever used. I have very fair skin with redness. After applying this cleanser my skin feels calm, clean, hydrated and without any signs of irritation. I do recommend it to anyone with red and dry skin.

This supposed to remove make up as well as cleanse but it doesn't not remove make up. I've only used it twice so I can't say if it helps redness yet. It didn't irritate my face at all or dry it out though so that's good. What make up remover would be good to use before this? Disappointed I will need multiple steps to clean my face.

I have very dry skin with mild rosacea. This cleanser works for me along with the Redness Solutions moisturizer and Moisture Surge 72 Hour with Lipids! They have gotten my rosacea under control. I also use Clinique Mineral Sunscreen for face 50 SPF.

This cleanser is what I've been searching for. I'm in my 40's w/normal skin and redness in my cheeks. This cleanser feels so clean and lightweight when using it. It does help with the redness. A little goes a very long way. No strong smell.

I rarely post reviews, but this formula has been a lifesaver. I recently started getting rosacea on my face. I've tried a lot of products before landing on this product. I use this in conjunction with the Redness Solutions Daily Relief Cream. I have been using these two products as directed 2x a day for the past 5 days, and I am astonished by the result. I wish I would have taken a before picture, but this product is amazing, and does actually work.
My face did not feel clean after washing with this cleanser. It felt watery not like the other cleansers. I prefer All About Clean for Dry Skin. I will be returning this product.

Honestly, I was recommended this months ago by one of the clinique workers at the store. I expressed my concern and she recommended this. I obviously gave it a few months to see how it worked. NO RESULTS. Honestly, I feel like it hasn't helped and hasn't helped cleanse my skin. My acne is worse than it was before and my redness hasn't been helped at all. I'd rather try to find something else since it seems this doesn't work AT ALL.

A fantastic gentle cleanser! I use this after "Take the Day Off" cleasing balm when wearing makeup & alone when not wearing makeup. It's creamy, gentle, oil free, doesn't strip my skin & leaves my skin very clean & soft! I didn't puchase this for it's anti-redness properties, but for it's gentleness. It really delivers & no breakouts! Fabulous product - will definitely repurchase.

I haven't noticed a reduction in redness yet but I probably haven't been using it long enough. I LOVE the consistency of this cleanser, it is so smooth and glides on easily - feels like velvet on the skin.

avis.titre: Made my face more red and made my rosacea worse
avis.texte: It is probably a personal thing, but I have been using this now for about 2 weeks and it caused more redness and made my rosacea worse. I switched back to the Cetaphil cleanser and my face feels so much better.

My skin was horribly dry and irritated with a red rash on my cheeks and neck in the winter. I tried a few different brands to try and calm my skin, but nothing worked until I found this cleanser and matching moisturizer. Within two days the irritation was greatly reduced, and was completely gone in one week. I use Clinique's cleansing balm to first remove sunscreen and a little makeup before I use the redness cleanser. I find this to be very soothing, rinses clean, and leaves my skin very soft.

If you have sensitive skin this is the cleanser for you! My skin turns blotchy and red when I cleanse with any other product. You can put this on your face and it melts away the make-up. You can rinse it off or you can wipe off with tissues.

I wanted so badly to like this, because my redness is so bad, and literally nothing has made it go down. This did nothing for my redness, although it is very gentle. Almost too gentle… I didn't feel like my skin was getting cleansed enough. After switching to this cleanser from my FAB Pure Skin, I've noticed more pimples and blackheads. If you have sensitive/normal skin that's not acne prone, you may like this, but there's other cheaper products that are probably just as good.
I love using this cleanser to soothe my skin during a breakout. Perfect cleanser when my skin is irritated from new product or too much sun exposure.

I tried it but my skin didn't feel like it was getting clean. It didn't help with the redness in my skin either. I was disappointed, over the years there aren't many protects I have been so disappointed with.

The first time I used this product, it made my skin itch. It was bad enough that about 20 minutes after washing my face with this, I rinsed my face off again hoping to rinse off any residue, and that helped. I buy Clinique products because they are good for sensitive skin, so this was a surprise.

I have suffered from rosacea for many years. For the first time I not only purchased the redness regimen face wash, I also purchased the redness regimen skin care protector, foundation and blush. I am just ecstatic with the results. The first time I used the redness regimen face wash my face appeared uniform in color with no apparent redness. I thought it might have been just coincidence but was pleasantly surprised to see consistent results since I began this regimen a week and 1/2 ago. I know people have shared inconsistent results but that has not been the case for me.

Have been dealing with rosacea for 10 years, have been to many docs, bought tons of products-some expensive-some kind of crazy. Been using this for a week and it works. Am so happy and anxious to try a few more products in this line.
Soothing cleanser. I can get redness in my cheeks in the winter if my skin gets dry or irritated and this helps with that. Rinses easily and preps for further skincare steps.

avis.titre: Better than the RX crashes I've tried
avis.texte: I have rosacea which presents itself in a red itchy rash on my cheeks and forehead. I've tried RX facial wash and creams from my dermatologist for years, but nothing has ever helped.... until I came across Redness Solutions. I've been using the 4 steps (wash, moisturizer, base and powder) for two weeks. While the redness itself my never go away completely, the red itchy rash on my face is completely gone. And the base and powder I use in the mornings hide the redness better than anything I've tried in the past. I am thrilled to find something gentle on my sensitive skin, that leaves my face soft and healthy looking and that also calms my itchy face.
I use this cleanser in the shower and I've notice the redness on my face isn't quite as intense. Definitely enjoying!

avis.titre: I really wanted to like this
avis.texte: I have very fair skin and as I get older, red shows through more and more. I thought this would be a solution, but sadly it's not. My fave doesn't feel clean after using it and I feel a tight film to my ski , no matter how much I rinse.

I have mild rosacea and sensitive skin. I love the redness solution moisturizer so I was looking forward to trying the face wash. Unfortunately it made me break out. I tried it for a week. Face cleared up after I stopped using it. It also doesn't have any lather.

I have been a rosecea sufferer for over 10 years. I've tried every calming, sensitive, and normal fash wash and cream. Outside of highly expensive perscription creams, gels, and oral medication nothing has worked. I decided to give this a try and do not regret it. I am very impressed! It has been only 3 days since I started this regimen and the results are undeniable. My face had improved greatly in just 3 or 4 washes. I was blown away. Results are amazing thus far. Also, makes my skin feel so nice!
Started using this 2 weeks ago and I have almost NO redness! I have dry/combo skin and this has helped with the dryness too and no oily t-zone. Found my new skincare line!
It is calming and soothing, however it does not take all the makeup off my skin.
I started to use it like my IT cleanser but it doesn't foam up. I had a major breakout while using it. I'll stick to the IT cleanser which is the best for me.
I immediately noticed and felt a difference in my skin when using this!
I really like the way this makes my face feel. It doesn't have a harsh feel like some cleansers. I do have rosacea so it keeps my face from additional inflammation that I had with other products.
Excellent remedy for skin redness with SPF 15. protects my skin from the sun's rays and hides redness, does not dry the skin, perfectly moisturizes.

My skin redness just had to go. I decided to invest in the Redness Solutions products and commit to a strict regimen every morning and every night, which definitely calmed and improved all the problematic areas. Remember, this is the 1st step.

avis.titre: Best Face Wash to Use with Retin-A
avis.texte: I got this on a whim (along with the redness solutions cream and moisture surge products) when I started using prescription Retin-A at night to try and stay ahead of the redness/peeling that typically comes with the medication's application (the retin-a is for lines, wrinkles, and even skin texture—not acne—I just turned 30). This face wash in particular has been amazing. My skin feels so soft and never stripped or dry after washing with it. I'm not sure if it's this product or this + the redness solutions daily cream, but I haven't had ANY issues with redness using Retin-A (and I have fairly sensitive skin). I've had some drying of course as to be expected, but I can say with certainty that this face wash has helped with the worst of that. 100% recommend this and I've been using it morning + night ever since, even after finishing the onboarding process for Retin-A with my skin "back to normal."

I use this daily. Usually if I wash my face 2x a day, it'll dry my skin or break me out. But with this one, my skin stays supple all day with using this twice daily. A small amount goes a long way. My redness in my cheeks and nose is more controlled. Typically my redness looks like it spreads or gets bigger or spreads, but not when I consistently use this. I bought it on sale bc the packaging was damaged, and now I'm hooked and willing to pay full price.

I purchased a Redness Solutions Soothing Cleanser not to make my cheeks and forehead turn pink/red. I would recommend people with any kind of skin sensitivity to use this with caution. This product was not a redness solution, but a redness causation for me and my strangely particular skin. I don't really have redness in my face unless it's hot outside, and my cheeks will be pink. When I finished washing my face, my cheeks and forehead were a nice pink/red and warm (I used cool water, not hot water. With other cleansers, my face does not turn pink/red.). Something inside of this cleanser is making my skin not like it. I'm glad that this works for others, but unfortunately, this did the opposite of what it was supposed to do for me.
This product really works. My red patches have disappeared. It took about a month for it to work. I still use it to keep it away.

avis.titre: Works Well w/ Other Redness Solutions Products
avis.texte: I use this as the first step in washing my face at night. I have always had a red face, especially at work, and it shows through makeup. Ugh! So, this, along with the other Redness Solutions products (Daily Relief Cream, Daily Protective Base, Instant Relief Mineral Powder, Makeup Foundation w/ Probiotic Technology) have pretty much left my skin feeling moisturized, cooled, and has almost eliminated redness (hasn't disappeared, but GREATLY reduced). You can use this with makeup on, even though the directions say "makeup free face". I just use a clean towel to remove the makeup residue. Sometimes I use the Take the Day Off makeup remover for my eyelids. I then slather on the Daily Stress Relief. That's all for my night routine! My daily makeup routine base uses (in this order) the Daily Stress Relief moisturizer, a liquid illuminating primer, a green color correction crayon, liquid concealer (if needed for blemishes), the liquid Makeup Foundation SPF w/ Probiotic Technology, then the Instant Relief Mineral Powder. I'll add highlighter, shadow, color, etc. after the base. Seriously, I sweat, get hot, etc. after walking around everywhere teaching and my face looks normal by the end of the day now that I'm using this regimen!
I love this cleanser. It is so gentle on my skin and it leaves it nice and soft. The redness solution collection has noticeable reduced my redness.
I loved this cleanser! It's very velvety, and really feels like it sinks into your skin when you use it. It doesn't irritate my skin at all, and actually feels hydrating for a cleanser.

Have used this for years helps with my redness on cheeks and now as I get older works great on my cheeks and my dry itchy jaw. I tried a couple of other face washes for sensitive skin but nothing helps as well as Clinique redness face wash does.

I have dry and sensitive skin that gets irritated and red often. The redness solutions line is perfect for me. This cleanser is easy to use because you can wipe or wash it off. It is gentle but leaves the skin feeling clean and soft. It seems expensive but I don't need much and therefore one tube lasts a long time. What amazes me about Clinique products is that they always smell great while being free of perfume.

avis.titre: Great product for those with redness in their skin!
avis.texte: Perfect facial cleansing product for those with redder than normal skin!!!

I've started off with the travel kit, I was very scare of trying anything new since my skin is very sensitive and I tried many products and always made my skin worse and ways I've heard good things about this product and I'm glad I gave it a tried I love it I use all the redness solution and use it day and night and sometimes in the afternoon to wash my face when I had a heavy day and I was off all the dirt of my face it's work for me

This soothing cleanser leaves my skin feeling soft and comfortable, with no tightness or irritation. It is creamy, and doesn't lather as stated in the product description, but gets the job done. On days I wear foundation I use a cleansing balm first. I use this with the entire redness solutions line and have found that over time not only has redness been diminished, but my skin is smoother and less bumpy as well.

I was using it faithfully morning and night and my rosacea was so calm and tone was very even. I wanted to try a different Clinique face wash and my face started to get red again. So I'll go back to this.

This face wash cleans really well, but when I put it on my face, it feels like it is burning, so I stopped using it. I'm not sure what is in it that is causing that feeling since Clinique products are supposed to be hypoallergenic. Whatever it is, my face is red when I finish washing my face, but my face felt clean.
I always had clear skin over the years I got redness and I thought this would help but instead it gave me acne, not the best purchase I had with Clinique and I've been using it Clinique for10 years
The product is creamy non-leathery, doesn't remove oil well. However, it is very useful when washing the face after acid treatment since it is soothing and non irritating

avis.titre: The one product I will actually rave about
avis.texte: For years I have had dry red scaley patches on my face, my hairline, eyelids, and eyebrows were dark red. Super embarrassing and nothing worked. Went to the dermatologist, used items for months that were supposed to work in a couple of weeks to see progress and it did not work for me. Long story short my roommate said I should try it and... when I tell you its the first time I have left the house without makeup to cover the redness for 7 years.... I am not lying. One generous use of it and the redness went away for almost 72 and took care of the REALLY BAD dryness. I saw results in literally 5-7 minutes.
Great cleanser, feels fresh, clean and vibrant after use. It's now part of daily regimen.

Obviously everyone's skin is different. My skin is normal/dry with red blotches (mainly on my cheeks, nose and chin). I've tried a few different products but due to my sensitive skin they usually cause more redness than anything. I can honestly say after just a few days of using this routine I've noticed a HUGE difference in my skin. It's more smooth, it feels hydrated and the redness has gone down a bit. I would definitely recommend this product.

My skin had allergic reaction to disposable masks - red, itchy, dry. This product was recommended to me during an online chat with Clinique. It's very mild, and gives me much less redness after cleansing comparing to other cleansers I've been using. I used it in the morning and with Redness Solutions cream daily and nightly. The redness was gone within a week! I guess I have to stick with it for a while.

I was on Rx medication for a few years for my rosacea but when my insurance stopped covering it had to find another solution. The rx was going to be more than $800 per month. I purchased the full line up and it has worked wonderfully. I used to layer the makeup to hide my red flare ups but now I don't even use a foundation or concealer. I highly recommend these products!

Bought this from Belk and used it for the first time yesterday and just like the Burt Bee's Sensitive, it actually made my face red red! Looked like I had a bad sunburn and was burning. Not sure what I am allergic to or why it did it. Hopefully it worked for other people, but not me :/
I use this product as a daily wash morning and especially after a workout...makes my face feel smooth and clean
Used daily for face cleanser, morning, after work outs, evening....great product

I just recently started using Clinique, I have always wanted to try it but did not have ANY idea on what line I should be using. I was looking over reviews on what type of cleanser to try out and since I have always struggled with redness on my face, this looked like a great option. I really like that the cleaner does not suds or foam, I have found that cleansers or soaps that foam or suds up, dry my skin out way more. I also have been using this with my Clairsonic brush in the evenings after a long day and it really seems to help get the grime off. I have not been wearing make up so I cannot attest to how well it cleans the skin if you have any make up residue... but i can attest to how well it washes off just the normal grime from going for walks and working out in the yard! I never realized how gross my face was prior... So far I am enjoying this cleaner, a little goes a long way so I am sure this tube will last me a while, but I will be very willing to order it again!

This came highly recommended to me by my roommate as I have normal to dry skin and a lot of redness. This honestly did nothing for my skin and I felt like I was breaking out more than I was before I started using the cleanser. I didn't notice it do anything for my redness, it honestly just made my skin a little smoother.

I use this product every night. It's the only cleanser that doesn't cause my skin to feel dried-out after washing it off, and I like the thick feel to it. I look forward to using it each night. I use this as my second cleanser.

Hands down the best cleanser for redness! the texture is a nice gel cream. It immediately calms and comforts my skin. I have eczema and rosacea and when my skin is aggravated everything burns except Clinique's redness solutions. This cleanser is the best for sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Calms skin, but doesn't reduce redness
avis.texte: I use this twice daily along with the other Clinique Redness Solutions products, and after using them for 5 months, I can honestly say that my redness has been reduced very slightly, but not enough for this to be a "wonder cure." I would still recommend it to anyone that has sensitive and dry skin because it's one of the only cleansers I can use that doesn't leave my skin stinging or tight afterward. I wish it was a bit cheaper.

I don't know if it really helps with my redness, but I love the way it feels. It's the best cleaner out there! It's super calming, non-irritating, and feels fresh when you rub in on your face. Love it!

This cleanser is very gentle on the skin and does not strip away oil. That being said, it is not meant to remove makeup. You need to use a makeup remover first then the cleanser. I really like it for that reason. It cleans my face, but leaves it balanced and not dry.

I didn't notice any redness reduced after using this product. I have mild rosacea and greasy skin and this didn't clean my skin very well and didn't relieve any rosacea symptoms. Not with the purchase price.

This product was recommended to me by the sales clerk many months ago. This last purchase was for my second tube of this product. It has changed the texture of my skin, and my complexion looks amazing.

avis.titre: I will continue buying this product
avis.texte: I talked with a rep for an hour and she set me up with a whole new routine. I explained that I had some redness and it bothers me since I don't wear make up much. Since using this product I've noticed so much change and the redness has subsided.
Of all the like products I've tried this one works the best. It helps tone down the redness of my rosacea.
I've been using this product to help some redness in my skin tone and it's really helping. I'm using a few other things in addition but this has really helped!
I used it when I felt I had issues with redness. Frankly speaking, I did not notice it making any difference in terms of either cleansing or calming or reducing redness.

I have fair skin, rosacea, live in Alaska. That is triple the problems for my skin during the winter months! So many products I've tried have either made my skin break out, left it feeling dry or greasy. Finally, I tried this cleanser and I love it!! It has really helped with the moisture level of my skin and helped a little with my rosacea. I definitely will keep on buying it.

So I have very sensitive skin and also suffer with rosacea. I did a lot of research to find a good cleanser to help with the redness and clean my face. This one came up a lot so i decided to try it. Well first time trying it I noticed It goes on more like a lotion than an actual cleanser. That wasn't a big deal to me so much I just wanted something that worked. Well at first I thought it was working great. My face was way less red after getting out the shower but the next day I noticed my face was starting to get really itchy. So it's safe to say this product just not agree with my skin and sadly I have to return it :(
Some cleansers are very harsh on my skin this one is not, makes my skin soft and smooth.
